summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus a same-day press release (Exhibits 99.1-99.3). No transaction, ownership change, or corporate action is disclosed. Reported revenue rose to $24.3M from $19.5M in the prior-year quarter, while the quarterly operating loss held near $17.8M and net loss was $20.3M ($0.24 per share). No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations appear; no risk-arb angle exists.
